name: Retrieve a list of emails
description: Retrieve a list of emails GET /emails
context:
GET /emails
Retrieve a list of emails
Optional: limit (query) — Number of items to return.; after (query) — Return items after this cursor.; before (query) — Return items before this cursor.

name: Retrieve a single email
Retrieve a list of attachments for a sent email
description: Retrieve a list of attachments for a sent email GET /emails/{email_id}/attachments
context:
GET /emails/{email_id}/attachments
Retrieve a list of attachments for a sent email
Required: email_id (path) — The ID of the email.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of attachments to return.; after (query) — Pagination cursor to fetch results after this attachment ID. Cannot be used with 'before'.; before (query) — Pagination cursor to fetch results before this attachment ID. Cannot be used with 'after'.

name: Retrieve a single attachment for a sent email
description: Retrieve a single attachment for a sent email GET /emails/{email_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}

name: Retrieve a list of received emails
description: Retrieve a list of received emails GET /emails/receiving
context:
GET /emails/receiving
Retrieve a list of received emails
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of received emails to return.; after (query) — Pagination cursor to fetch results after this email ID. Cannot be used with 'before'.; before (query) — Pagination cursor to fetch results before this email ID. Cannot be used with 'after'.
